question: Is the score lost to retrieval or to ordering?
method: tools/recall.py replays the official session loop with Agent.trace_pool on, recording per turn whether the target was in the candidate pool the scorer ranked over, and where the untruncated internal ranking put it.
findings: On every official session the target is in the pool from turn one. There is no retrieval headroom on the public harness at all; 100% of the remaining official score is ordering and turn count.
Category-head-noun synonym is the only axis where retrieval genuinely breaks, and there it is 6x the ranking loss (0.090 vs 0.015). Any recall work is justified by this axis alone.
The scaffold axis loses nothing to recall. Its loss was entirely shelf resolution feeding a weaker primary boost, which is why fixing exact_bucket moved it and a recall route would not have.

Consequence for the roadmap: 'recall under paraphrase' was the wrong headline. The shelf-resolution bug was cheaper and larger, and product-level recall fusion is worth at most 0.09 hit rate on one synthetic axis.
